description: Utilities for running WebAssembly modules. Supports executing WASI-compatible WebAssembly modules with configurable arguments, environment variables, and input/output handling.

instructions.description: Loads and runs a WASI module. The module must be available at the given path. This function is returning standard output from the WASI module execution.
instructions.name: Run WASI

parameters.description: Arguments to pass to WASI module.
parameters.name: args

parameters.description: Standard input to pass to WASI module.
parameters.name: input

parameters.description: Environment variables to pass to WASI module.
parameters.name: env
